extracted.name: Classic Smoked Sausage & Peppers
extracted.description: Sliced smoked sausage is sauteed with onions and red and green bell peppers for a quick and colorful weeknight dinner.
ingredient_lines: 1 (14 ounce) package Hillshire Farm® Smoked Sausage, diagonally cut into 1/4-inch slices
2 cups red and green peppers, cut into 1-inch pieces
instruction_lines: Saute sausage in a large skillet over medium-high heat for 3 minutes, turning occasionally.
Add olive oil, onion, peppers and oregano, cooking until tender, about 3 minutes.
Remove from heat, stir in Parmesan cheese.
